findings.interpretation: 107.9/3.602 = 29.96 days as a gross stock-to-recent-domestic-use ratio. This calculation is not EIA published days-supply in this retrieval, a countdown to exhaustion, or protected essential-service coverage. Production/imports continue; exports, operating floors, grades, location and delivery access matter.
findings.title: Stocks improved for one week while reserve remained below seasonal context

findings.falsifier: Sustained product export recovery, rebuilding accessible distillate stocks, and normal lead times would weaken the ongoing squeeze hypothesis.
findings.forecast_separate: IEA defers full Gulf supply recovery into 2027; this is a forecast, not an established restoration date.
findings.statement: IEA estimates August observed global oil inventories fell 95 million barrels and Gulf plus Russian net diesel/gasoil exports were 1.6 million barrels/day below February. It reports refinery-throughput losses in crude-importing Asia and higher freight costs. These observations support a physical constraint, beyond price alone.
findings.title: IEA reports reduced physical flows alongside prices

findings.interpretation: Rising cost cannot be read as rising volume at the same rate. Neither this monthly flow nor IEA regional estimates measure voyage-time delays. Country-specific arrival timing remains unknown.
findings.statement: Japan provisional August PETROLEUM import quantity was 11,594 thousand kilolitres, up 3.6% year over year; import value rose 58.7%.
findings.title: Japan provides counterevidence to a blanket East Asian import decline

findings.interpretation: It cannot be counted as freely available California or global donor stock. Release authority, beneficiaries, delivery and protected local needs still govern usable cover.
findings.statement: DOE describes approximately one million barrels of ultra-low-sulfur distillate in the Northeast Home Heating Oil Reserve and an emergency auction release process.
findings.title: A designated refined-product reserve exists but has a defined regional mission

findings.statement: CME confirms HO contract size 42,000 gallons and quotation in dollars/cents per gallon, but retrieved page supplied no current settlement. EIA suspended its futures table in April 2024. IEA reports Brent at $105/barrel, $21 above early August, but without a specified contract/month and timestamp, so this is attributed market commentary rather than a reproducible contract series.
findings.title: Exact latest NY Harbor ULSD and ICE gasoil futures contract comparison remains unverified

buffers: Usable specification-compatible local stock after operating floors
Confirmed replenishment on routes outside the initiating hazard
Local trades or swaps backed by actual inventory and transport
Refinery yield/run adjustments only within engineering and feed constraints
Essential-load prioritization, reduced idling and consolidated trips
Suitable existing rail routes after checking total diesel and first/last mile
findings.donor_floor: Any transfer must leave the donor its operating minimum, essential demand cover and contingency margin; those quantities are currently unknown.
findings.falsifier: Independent replenishment arrives before the floor crossing and usable inventories recover without sacrificing essential donor service.
growth: Repair and maintenance preserving fuel efficiency
findings.lifeboat: A defined essential transport/refrigeration service supplied by compatible physically deliverable fuel, or an independently powered substitute; not an unallocated national stock number.
findings.mechanism: A shipment delay draws down usable stock; swaps, alternative routes and compatible refinery output can replace some arrivals, while safe demand reduction slows depletion. Crude cannot directly fill diesel tanks. High refinery utilization limits easy headroom.
findings.threshold: Escalate when conservative confirmed replenishment arrives after the protected-floor crossing date, or local rationing/non-delivery corroborates the national signal.
findings.title: Time cover is governed by net draw, deliverability and the next replacement
